title: Monthly Updates [Jan] & Happy New Year!
description: Happy New Year everyone! We've made a lot of progress this year.

blocks.markdown: Hi everyone, happy new year! As we bid farewell to '23, let's take a moment to reflect on the remarkable journey FMHY has had this year:

items.markdown: We made a new website, enriched with an array of handcrafted features (by me,

children.markdown: of course) to enhance your experience and make browsing the wiki pleasant on all devices (mobile included!).

items.markdown: We opened our Discord server and reached 10k members, which introduced many

children.markdown: great new people to this community and made contribution easy.

items.markdown: We've reached 250k+ members and 31 million views on Reddit!
Our FMHYedit repository oversaw an impressive 1k+ pull requests made by the

children.markdown: community and merged over 8k commits!

items.markdown: This wiki has grown to be more than just a piracy index, so we felt it's about

children.markdown: time other sections get some love. As such, we organized and separated tools sections into their own pages, which allowed us to move a lot of useful tools out of storage and make it a lot easier to discover them.

items.markdown: We started the debloat arc of FMHY and went from 27k links to 24k! We've

children.markdown: removed a lot of dead, useless, and niche links / categories, as well as re-organized a lot of sections for better clarity and easier navigation.

blocks.markdown: As we enter 2024, we eagerly anticipate building on our achievements and evolving together. FMHY wouldn't be what it is today without the love and support of everyone in this community. Thank you for being an integral part of FMHY. Here's to another year of growth and success! 💙

items.markdown: Made our own instances for both **[SearX](https://searx.fmhy.net/)** +

children.markdown: **[Whoogle](https://whoogle.fmhy.net/)**.

items.markdown: Made a [Posts](/posts) page on our site, so you can see all updates without

children.markdown: needing Reddit. You can also follow via [RSS](/feed.rss).

items.markdown: Created a new category for [Social Media Tools](/social-media-tools) and

children.markdown: added subsections for popular sites that needed them (Reddit, Discord, YouTube, etc.).

items.markdown: Added sections for [Game Soundtracks](/audio#game-soundtracks),

children.markdown: [IRC Tools](/downloading#irc-tools), and [Coding AIs](/developer-tools#coding-ais).

items.markdown: Split Career into subsections: [Remote Jobs](/misc#remote-jobs),

children.markdown: [Tech Jobs](/misc#tech-jobs), [Startup](/misc#startup), and [Finance / Crypto](/misc#finance-crypto).

items.markdown: Split Game Mods into subsections:

children.markdown: [Mod Indexes](/gaming#mod-indexes) and [Single Mods](/gaming#game-mods).

items.markdown: Split News into subsections: [Aggregators](/misc#aggregators) and

children.markdown: [Tech News](/misc#tech-news).

items.markdown: Re-organized both

children.markdown: [Android Operating Systems](/mobile#operating-systems) + [App Launchers](/mobile#app-launchers), and moved them out of storage.

items.markdown: Starred [Braflix](/video#streaming-sites) in Streaming Sites. Fast

children.markdown: streams, no ads, nice UI, 4K + 1080p.

items.markdown: Starred [Liber3](/reading#ebooks) in Reading Sites. Big library,

children.markdown: nice UI, single-click downloads.

items.markdown: Starred [Screenbox](/video-tools#video-players) in Video Players. Open-source,

children.markdown: VLC-based video player with a nice UI.

items.markdown: Starred [Vesktop](/social-media-tools#discord-clients) in Discord Clients.

children.markdown: Lightweight desktop client built with Vencord.

items.markdown: Starred [SydneyQt](/ai#proprietary-llms) in AI Chatbots. Jailbroken Bing AI.
Starred [App Manager](/mobile#foss-apks) in FOSS APKs. Open-source

children.markdown: Android app package manager.

items.markdown: Starred [scrcpy](/mobile#android-device) in Android Tools. Manage

children.markdown: mobile devices via desktop.

items.markdown: Starred [KernelSU](/mobile#android-device) in Android Device. Root

children.markdown: tool that some people prefer over Magisk.

items.markdown: Starred [Onion Browser](/mobile#ios-privacy) in iOS Privacy.

children.markdown: Recommended by Tor on their site.

items.markdown: Starred [Wii Guide](/gaming#homebrew) in Homebrew.
Starred [Video2x](/video-tools#video-tools-1) in Video Tools. Lossless

children.markdown: video/GIF/image upscaler.

items.markdown: Starred [VCRedist](/system-tools#windows-updates) in Windows Updates. Easily

children.markdown: download all Microsoft Visual C++ redists.

items.markdown: Starred [CanvasBlocker](/privacy#privacy-extensions) in Privacy

children.markdown: Extensions. Prevent JavaScript API fingerprinting.

items.markdown: Removed SevenGamers as they've

children.markdown: [decided to shut down](https://i.imgur.com/C5sgVqI.png).

items.markdown: Removed YasDL as they uploaded a version of StarDock with the same malware

children.markdown: that filecr and others have gotten removed for.

items.markdown: Removed Torrentz2 as they've stopped indexing new torrents.
Unstarred LookMovie as they've added a

children.markdown: [10-second wait](https://i.imgur.com/I0D9Hyt.png) before videos play.

items.markdown: Unstarred DS4Windows in gaming tools. You can just add games to Steam and turn

children.markdown: on PS4 controller support by right-clicking the game.

items.markdown: Unstarred Ideogram as it's no longer unlimited.
Removed EveryNoiseAtOnce as the dev has been

children.markdown: [let go from Spotify](https://i.imgur.com/AaIrcAc.png).

items.markdown: Removed CryptoStorm as it's [possibly unsafe](https://i.imgur.com/VDlSY1T.png).

children.markdown: The owner has no ties to it anymore apparently, but it's still hard to trust a company with a history this dark.

items.markdown: Removed our backups from NotABug. Their site goes down nearly

children.markdown: [every day](https://i.imgur.com/Vx8Ou68.png) at this point, and it's become a nightmare to keep 25 wiki pages updated there. If they ever fix their issues we may bring it back.
